# Peaknizer Logistics

> Peaknizer Logistics is a third-party logistics (3PL) company with its head office in Arlington, Virginia, and warehouses in Houston, Texas and New Jersey. It provides product prep, warehousing and order fulfillment for Amazon, Walmart, eBay and Shopify sellers and small brands across the USA.

Contact: info@peaknizerlogistics.com | +1 (571) 307-4461

- [Home](https://peaknizerlogistics.com/): What we do and who we serve

- [About](https://peaknizerlogistics.com/about): Company background and team
